newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau reports over 8 million visitors in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Macau reports over 8 million visitors in 1996.

text.p: Visitor arrivals in Macau was up 5.1 percent last year, totalling 8.1 million visitors, the Macau government said on Thursday.

Daily average visitor arrivals to the Portuguese-administered territory on the southern Chinese coast reached 22,270 in 1996, corresponding to nearly five percent of the local population of just over 450,000, the government said.
The average room occupancy rate of Macau's three- to five-star hotels reached 79 percent, it said.
About 390,000 visitors arrived at the Macau International Airport, which opened on November 9, 1995, it said.
